title: When breaking fast in someone's home
title_arabic: الدعاء إذا أفطر عند أهل بيت

duas.dua_english: With you, those who are fasting have broken their fast, you have fed those who are righteous, and the angels recite their prayers upon you.
duas.dua_transliteration: Afṭara \`indakumuṣ-ṣā'imūn, wa akala ṭa\'āmakumu 'l-'abrār, wa ṣallat \`alaykumu 'l-malā'ikah.
duas.dua_arabic: أَفْطَـرَ عِنْدَكُم الصّـائِمونَ وَأَكَلَ طَعامَـكُمُ الأبْـرار، وَصَلَّـتْ عَلَـيْكُمُ الملائِكَـة
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 3/367, Ibn Majah 1/556, An-Nasa'i, 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylah 296-8. Al-Albani graded it authentic in Sahih Abu Dawud 2/730.
duas.occasion: When breaking fast in someone's home

description: This chapter contains the dua to be recited when breaking one's fast (iftar) in someone's home, invoking blessings upon the household.
